name: Koei Tecmo Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Koei Tecmo Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates as an entertainment company in Japan, North America, Europe, Asia, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Entertainment Business, Amusement Business, and Real Estate Business. The Entertainment Business segment engages in the development and sale of entertainment content under the brands KOU SHIBUSAWA, w-Force, Team NINJA, Gust, Ruby Party, and midas; and provision of entertaining contents on a various platforms, from software for personal computers, family consoles, online games, smartphone apps, and more.
